page_title: EVE 2-1 CRY | Everton v Crystal Palace 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Jordan Pickford (Everton) receives a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
89' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
89' The referee allows time for a substitution. Adam Wharton will be replaced by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace).
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Everton.
86' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
86' James Garner (Everton) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
85' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
84' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
84' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) heads on.
83' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. James Garner (Everton) replaces Orel Mangala.
83' That will be all from Dwight McNeil who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Idrissa Gueye (Everton).
82' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
82' Corner kick. Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is ready to send the ball into the box.
81' The ball is cleared after Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
78' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
77' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) makes a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Andy Madley blows for a foul after Dwight McNeil (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
73' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) for Eddie Nketiah.
72' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
71' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
70' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
67' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) misses a complete sitter from the corner, heading the ball well wide of the left post from close in.
67' Dwight McNeil (Everton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
64' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) has a shot blocked from inside the box.

63' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Daichi Kamada leaves the pitch and Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) comes on.
62' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
59' Dwight McNeil (Everton) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
57' Foul! Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
57' Everton are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
54' 2 - 1 Goal! Jack Harrison puts a cross into the box and finds Dwight McNeil (Everton), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:1.
53' Andy Madley couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) and blew his whistle.
50' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
47' 1 - 1 Dwight McNeil (Everton) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
46' Sean Dyche makes a switch. Jack Harrison is coming on in place of Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save.
43' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) causes Jordan Pickford little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
40' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
37' Dwight McNeil (Everton) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
36' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:2.
34' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
33' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
30' Some patient build-up play from Everton as they look to unlock the defence.
26' Wow, what an escape. Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
26' Crystal Palace work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) meets the corner with a powerful well-placed header that beats the keeper, but the close-range effort is superbly blocked on the goal line by a defender. Unlucky!
26' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) will take a corner kick.
24' Dwight McNeil (Everton) tries to find Dominic Calvert-Lewin, but he puts too much power on the pass.
22' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes a weak connection with the corner kick, and his close-range header is easily blocked.
22' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
22' Dwight McNeil (Everton) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
20' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Dean Henderson has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
19' The game is interrupted. James Tarkowski (Everton) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
18' Andy Madley interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Orel Mangala (Everton).
16' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
15' Everton will take a corner kick.
14' James Tarkowski (Everton) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
13' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) commits a rough foul. Andy Madley stops the game and makes a call.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Maxence Lacroix gets to the ball and heads it over the defence to Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace), who meets it nicely and fires in into the back of the net. 0:1.
10' The linesman makes the right call and Crystal Palace will have a corner.
10' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
8' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
6' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
5' Ashley Young (Everton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andy Madley saw the whole situation.
4' Crystal Palace are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The match has just started.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Andy Madley is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
